requirements.requirement: The system should be usable by people who are not online-savvy.
requirements.source_citation: People — even those who aren't online-savvy — can find and watch a film without getting frustrated.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the system to be usable by people who are not online-savvy, indicating a strong focus on usability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific usability testing methods will be used to ensure the system meets the needs of non-tech-savvy users?

requirements.requirement: The system should have a straightforward and obvious user interface.
requirements.source_citation: It should be straightforward. I mean, most people should be able to use it without training. It should feel obvious where to go, how to buy, how to play a movie.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasizes the importance of a straightforward and obvious user interface, which is a key aspect of usability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific design guidelines or heuristics will be followed to ensure the user interface is straightforward and obvious?

requirements.requirement: The sign-up process should be fast and not annoying, with a maximum of four pages.
requirements.source_citation: Signing up should be fast and not annoying. We don't want ten pages of forms or anything like that — just the essentials so people don't drop off mid-signup. Users should reach an account within about four pages at most.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for a fast and not annoying sign-up process with a maximum of four pages, indicating a strong focus on usability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the speed and annoyance level of the sign-up process?

requirements.requirement: The checkout flow should be frictionless and take under three minutes from deciding to buy to seeing the first frame.
requirements.source_citation: The flow has to be frictionless. A customer should be able to pick a movie, pay, and start watching with very little clicking or waiting. The moment of truth is being able to actually play the movie quickly after deciding to buy. By quick I mean a few minutes — it should be under three minutes from deciding to buy to seeing the first frame, assuming their internet isn't terrible.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for a frictionless checkout flow that takes under three minutes, indicating a strong focus on usability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the friction level and time taken for the checkout flow?

requirements.requirement: The system should feel snappy, with small interactions happening almost instantly.
requirements.source_citation: It has to feel snappy. Small interactions need to happen almost instantly; long waits are a real churn risk.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the system to feel snappy with small interactions happening almost instantly, indicating a strong focus on performance.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the snappiness and responsiveness of the system?

requirements.requirement: Page load times should be roughly five seconds for usual actions like loading a page or adding to cart.
requirements.source_citation: If I had to pick a number, I'd say roughly five seconds for the usual things, like loading a page or adding to cart. Any longer and people notice and get annoyed.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for page load times to be roughly five seconds, indicating a strong focus on performance.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the page load times and user satisfaction?

requirements.requirement: Credit card processing should take up to around fifteen seconds.
requirements.source_citation: I think up to around fifteen seconds is acceptable for a card transaction; beyond that we start seeing abandoned attempts or duplicate charges from panicked users.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for credit card processing to take up to around fifteen seconds, indicating a strong focus on performance.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the credit card processing time and user satisfaction?

requirements.requirement: The system should support generating and redeeming pre-paid cards simply for admins and users.
requirements.source_citation: Generating and redeeming those should be simple for admins and for users.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the system to support generating and redeeming pre-paid cards simply, indicating a strong focus on usability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the simplicity and usability of the pre-paid card generation and redemption process?

requirements.requirement: The system should keep working if the external payment provider has an outage, with graceful degradation.
requirements.source_citation: The system should keep working if our external payment provider has an outage; we can't have the whole site go dark because the gateway hiccupped. Right, browsing should definitely continue. Ideally people could redeem pre-paid codes or use balances even if the gateway is down. We want graceful degradation so revenue isn't completely blocked and users don't get the impression the whole business collapsed.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the system to keep working during payment provider outages with graceful degradation, indicating a strong focus on fault tolerance.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the system's ability to handle payment provider outages and maintain graceful degradation?

requirements.requirement: Buffering should generally finish within about ten seconds.
requirements.source_citation: Buffering should generally finish within about ten seconds, plus whatever lag the user's connection adds. So the system shouldn't introduce the delay.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for buffering to finish within about ten seconds, indicating a strong focus on performance.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the buffering time and user satisfaction?

requirements.requirement: The system should have an uptime of ninety-nine and a half percent availability.
requirements.source_citation: We need it to be up almost all the time. If pressed, our goal is something like ninety-nine and a half percent availability over the year.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the system to have an uptime of ninety-nine and a half percent availability, indicating a strong focus on availability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics will be used to measure the system's uptime and availability?

requirements.requirement: Only a few trusted people should be able to access full card details.
requirements.source_citation: Only a few trusted people should be able to access full card details, and access should be strictly controlled.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for limited access to full card details, indicating a strong focus on security.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific access control mechanisms will be implemented to ensure only trusted people can access full card details?

requirements.requirement: Payment information needs to be encrypted in the database.
requirements.source_citation: The payment information needs to be encrypted in the database.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for payment information to be encrypted in the database, indicating a strong focus on security.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific encryption standards and protocols will be used to encrypt payment information in the database?

requirements.requirement: A clear privacy policy should be accessible from anywhere on the site.
requirements.source_citation: A clear privacy policy that they can access is important, and it should be obvious — not buried. It should be reachable from anywhere on the site.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for a clear and accessible privacy policy, indicating a strong focus on legal compliance and user trust.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific content and design guidelines will be followed to ensure the privacy policy is clear and accessible?

requirements.requirement: Admins need actionable business analytics dashboards to spot trends and notice issues.
requirements.source_citation: Admins need actionable business analytics: what sells, viewing patterns, revenue trends — the usual marketing and operations signals. The dashboards should let us spot a title that's suddenly trending, or notice when purchases drop so we can react.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for actionable business analytics dashboards, indicating a strong focus on maintainability and operational efficiency.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics and visualizations will be included in the business analytics dashboards to support trend spotting and issue noticing?

requirements.requirement: Access to admin dashboards should be role-based.
requirements.source_citation: Access should be role-based. Not everyone needs the same things; some people need full reports, others just a summary. We don't want broad access to everything.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for role-based access to admin dashboards, indicating a strong focus on security and access control.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific role-based access control mechanisms will be implemented to ensure appropriate access levels for different users?

requirements.requirement: The platform must manage the codes and redemptions of pre-paid cards cleanly.
requirements.source_citation: The platform must manage the codes and redemptions cleanly.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the platform to manage pre-paid card codes and redemptions cleanly, indicating a strong focus on scalability and operational efficiency.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific processes and systems will be implemented to ensure clean management of pre-paid card codes and redemptions?

requirements.requirement: The design should reflect an African aesthetic but be modern and simple.
requirements.source_citation: It should reflect an African aesthetic, but, you know, modern and simple so people don't get lost.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for the design to reflect an African aesthetic while being modern and simple, indicating a strong focus on look and feel.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific design principles and guidelines will be followed to ensure the design reflects an African aesthetic while being modern and simple?

requirements.requirement: The system should support localized text and payment options for users in different countries.
requirements.source_citation: We need localized text and payment options for users in different countries — sometimes people prefer mobile money, sometimes pre-paid cards you can buy in a shop.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for localized text and payment options, indicating a strong focus on portability and user convenience.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific localization and payment integration strategies will be implemented to support users in different countries?
